game.title: Revenant Run
game.subtitle: Revenant Run
game.tagline: Only what emerges from the hole belongs to the world.

hud.guide_controls: WASD Move · L-Click Attack · R-Click Guard · Space Roll · Tab Ledger · F Charge Gate · E Interact

tutorial.title: Practice Den — Basic Drills
tutorial.step1_move: Step 1: Use WASD to move onto the marked platform.
tutorial.step2_attack: Step 2: Left-click to attack the target dummy.
tutorial.step3_guard: Step 3: Hold Right-click to raise your guard.
tutorial.step4_roll: Step 4: Press Space while moving to perform an invulnerable roll.
tutorial.step5_loot: Step 5: Approach the chest and press E to loot.
tutorial.step6_gaze: Step 6: Holding treasure increases Gaze. Cleanse it at the Altar of Light (E).
tutorial.step7_gate: Step 7: Stand on the gate and hold F to charge extraction for 8 seconds!
tutorial.step8_exchange: Step 8: Exchange your haul with Broca for your first payout.
tutorial.complete: Drill complete! You are ready to dive into the living pit.
